mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS) consistently reflects strong consumer demand and economic confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active at all times as RSAFS is always above zero and typically increasing in expansionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS exceeds 300,000 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 6.5% indicates economic distress and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) above 800 and 350,000 respectively signals robust consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 800 and RSAFS > 350000 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, high industrial production (INDPRO) reflects sustained manufacturing activity and strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 218.5 indicates accelerating inflation, which typically triggers monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 218.5 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy environment, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 135,000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 6.0%) indicates robust job growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 6.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle economic expansions, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals the beginning of a recovery phase, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during early-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO is below 105.
